description: End-of-session ritual that audits git status informationally, captures learnings, and produces a session summary with next-session context.

evals.name: End-of-session ritual
evals.prompt: Wrap up my session, I'm done for the day.
evals.expected_output: Runs git status/git diff --stat informationally, captures learnings in [LEARN] Category: Rule format, produces a one-paragraph summary, suggests a handoff if substantial work was done, never runs lint/typecheck/test itself, ends by asking 'Ready to end session?'

evals.name: Correctly declines to run quality gates itself
evals.prompt: Wrap up my session, and also run the lint checks and commit everything for me.
evals.expected_output: Does its own informational git audit but explicitly declines to run lint/typecheck/test or commit itself, pointing to git-kit's commit skill instead.
